owner_text: Rosalind Adeyemi, I'm the manager at Little Acorn Academy. Apologies if I get cut off, it's snack time.
We look after children from babies to eight years old: a nursery and an after-school club.
Sorry, someone has just spilled a whole jug of juice. Back in a second.
While I think, can you tell me roughly what this costs?
Eighteen staff, two sites.
Parents phone, email, message us through the parent app, or catch us at the front desk. Roughly 40 a day.
It takes me about 6 minutes to handle each one.
Actually no, 4 is nearer. The 6 is for the tricky ones.
Four. Six is only the tricky ones.
The rain has cancelled the garden session, so all the children are in the hall. Chaos.
Then 2 minutes of typing it up afterwards.
I'll send our front desk guide, it has the whole routine.
Late pickup messages getting missed, absence notes on scraps of paper, and typing attendance twice.
Messages that get missed, and attendance entered twice.
The absence notices, pickup messages and attendance entry. We'd like to grow the club, which means less admin.
The attendance spreadsheet saves as CSV.
Yes, the children's names, parents' contact details and medical notes.
Yes. Calls about a sick child, and last-minute pickup changes.
We haven't set any money aside, I can't say.
Next quarter, when the new term begins.
rosalind@example.invalid
